title: Chapter 89: Beasts Gather
content:
Chapter 89: Beasts Gather

After Gong Zheng got the equipment, his expression did not change.

This made Wang Shuo a little helpless!

Wang Shuo planned to let him change his job to a shield soldier in the future, so that his defense could be taken to the next level.

After a while of excitement.

If Gong Zheng is Wang Shuo's strongest shield, then Ayub is undoubtedly his strongest spear.

After thinking again and again, Wang Shuo decided to give Ayub the certificate of the general's job change.

At the same time, he also gave him the chain mail, which was as good as the rock armor.

As for the others, Wang Shuo also armed them with the good things he could use as much as possible.

As for the other golden weapon, the long axe, Wang Shuo did not have a suitable candidate.

The next morning.

Wang Shuo was still eating breakfast.

The system prompt sounded.

[The angry beasts could no longer tolerate the players' slaughter of them, and were determined to unite and eliminate the humans in their territory. ]

Wang Shuo rolled his eyes, but his face was cold.

The invasion of the beasts finally began.

At this time, all the beasts in the Dahuai area were gathering in an orderly manner.

They seemed to have received some kind of order. Even though they were natural enemies at ordinary times, they strangely maintained peace at this moment.

Wolves, rhinos, hippos, snakes, eagles...

Countless animals gathered together in groups, and some powerful beasts led them.

Almost every bronze boss level has opened up their intelligence.

Some have the IQ of a 3-year-old child, while others have the intelligence of an adult.

They are ready to fight, quietly waiting for other kinds of beasts to join them.

Wang Shuo climbed up the outer wall and looked from a high place.

Around Wana Village, there are densely packed animals of various kinds, the number is immeasurable.

It made his scalp numb.

It seems that they will gather for at least one hour.

Back in the meeting room, he opened the [Changping County Lord Channel].

This channel, which is jokingly called the "Village Head Group", currently has nearly 5,000 people.

As long as the lord who established the village, they will automatically join.

There are many villages with less than 10 people, so the number of village chiefs seems a bit too much.

Pitt with diarrhea: "Tian Shou, there are so many beasts. I pack up and go to the system town immediately. Is it too late?"

Go straight to Huanglong: "I didn't find so many beasts when I was leveling up! How many people do you have? Can you bear it?"

Emperor Zetian: "My current location is 40 kilometers north of Wadang Mountain. Fellow countrymen who think they can't stop me can come closer to me."

Wang Shuo's heart trembled slightly when he saw this message.

There is actually a neighbor less than 50 kilometers away from him.

He thought about it and greeted the other party!

At the same time, he can also test the other party's strength.

Red Panda: " @Emperor Zetian, how many people are there in your territory? If we come here, can we accommodate them?"

Emperor Zetian: "Of course, my Fengze Village has more than 400 people now. We have sufficient food, complete defense facilities, and excellent weapons and equipment. As long as you join us, we will definitely be able to survive this crisis safely."

There are more than 400 people. Wang Shuo frowned and thought about it.

After thinking for a while, he ignored this person.

Go to him? Wang Shuo didn't even think about it.

Then he opened the [Chat Channel of Hedong County].

There are more people in this place. At the beginning, there were 250,000 people, but now there are only 230,000 people left.

In just a few days, 20,000 people have been eliminated.

It is estimated that these people are either too weak or too unlucky.

This time the beasts attacked the village, like a "monthly exam".
